controls.name: C_model_is_not_the_measurement
controls.must_fire_because: the descriptor sum is computed by a SEPARATE traversal that hashes nothing, so it can disagree with the counting hashlib. If the two were the same code the agreement would be a tautology and the falsifier could not fire
controls.can_fail_because: no row was measured at all, or the model returned zero bytes for a non-empty answer set
controls.null_must_contain: an implementation hashing anything outside node_hash -- a length prefix, a separator, a second pass -- would show up as slack

controls.name: C_answer_sets_are_non_trivial
controls.must_fire_because: a query returning one key would make the subtrie a single node and the decomposition trivially content-only, which would answer nothing about the regime S20 measured
controls.can_fail_because: any row's mean answer set is below 2 keys
controls.null_must_contain: single-key answers, where digests are 0 and the share question does not arise

controls.name: C_shares_sum_to_the_whole
controls.must_fire_because: content + framing + digests + the path fold must account for byte; a fourth category would mean the decomposition is not the node_hash definition it claims to be
controls.can_fail_because: the three parts do not sum to the descriptor total on any row
controls.null_must_contain: a node_hash that fed sha256 something outside those three categories

falsifiers.name: F_implementation_slack
falsifiers.can_fail_because: measured verifier bytes exceed the descriptor sum by more than 1.0% on any key set
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a verifier doing a second pass, or hashing framing of its own, which would show as positive slack
falsifiers.refutes: S20's open item -- if the verifier hashes more than the root's definition requires, the 2-4x is slack a better verifier could remove
falsifiers.fires_when: measured verifier bytes exceed the descriptor sum by more than 1.0% on any key set
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: verifier bytes exceeding the answer subtrie's descriptor sum by more than 1.0%, which would make the 2-4x constant implementation slack rather than the commitment format
